links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of LLM patient education responses on hyperthyroidism
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease classified all three LLMs' text as 'Difficult' (DeepSeek: 38, Gemini: 38, ChatGPT: 37).
links.quote: Notably, The Flesch Reading Ease Index classified the text generated by all three LLMs as ‘Difficult’ to read (DeepSeek: 38, Gemini: 38, ChatGPT: 37).

screen.reason: Evaluates performance and readability of three commercial LLMs answering patient education questions about hyperthyroidism without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
